encode_grid_coordinates: encode 3D grid coordinates into space-filling curve codes using z-order or hilbert ordering with optional batch IDs
decode_space_filling_codes: decode space-filling curve codes back into 3D grid coordinates and batch IDs using z-order or hilbert ordering
encode_z_order_curve: encode 3D grid coordinates into z-order space-filling curve codes with configurable depth
encode_hilbert_curve: encode 3D grid coordinates into hilbert space-filling curve codes with configurable depth
decode_hilbert_curve: decode hilbert space-filling curve codes back into 3D grid coordinates with configurable depth
